output.subject: Your message about tap to pay on your new card
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for getting in touch with us about your new card.

You told us that tap to pay on your new card doesn't work anywhere you've tried it, although the chip works fine. You mentioned it's more annoying than urgent. We understand how inconvenient it is when a feature you expect to use every day doesn't work, and we're sorry for the frustration this has caused.

You also asked whether we can send you a replacement card with tap to pay that works. We've noted that request.

Our Card Services team will review what you've described, including your request for a replacement, and we will respond within 10 business days. If anything changes in the meantime, for example if tap to pay starts working or you notice a different problem with the card, please let us know so we can include it in the review.

Thank you for your patience.

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Check whether contactless is enabled on the customer's card and account.
Check whether the card needs a first chip-and-PIN transaction before contactless works, and tell the customer if so.
Check for any known contactless faults affecting this card type or batch.
Decide whether to issue a replacement card, as the customer requested.
Add any interim guidance or practical next steps the customer can take before sending.
